changeSet.sql: UPDATE savbillrevenuemanagement.TBLTCREDITDOC t1 JOIN ( SELECT CREDITDOCID, CUSTID, referenceno, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTID, referenceno ORDER BY CREDITDOCID) AS row_num FROM savbillrevenuemanagement.TBLTCREDITDOC ) t2 ON t1.CREDITDOCID = t2.CREDITDOCID SET t1.referenceno = NULL WHERE t2.row_num > 1;
